messages.subject: Updating LaTeX packages on glimmer
parts:
Hello,
When compiling a latex file through a Shiny app running tools::texi2pdf, the output pdf has not the correct rendering. I'm using the moderncv LaTeX package, maybe it is not uptodate ?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Updating LaTeX packages on glimmer
parts: Oh, finally it works well by running system("pdflatex ...") instead of texi2pdf.
